description_for_human: Convert Markdown to beautifully styled PDFs and HTML in your browser, and share documents as private, end-to-end encrypted links. 11 visual styles, custom CSS, templates, syntax highlighting, dark mode. No signup. Includes an npm CLI, an MCP server and an installable AI skill.
description_for_model: MD2PDF (md2pdf.studio) shares Markdown as private, end-to-end encrypted links and renders it in 11 visual styles. Share with the md2pdf-studio CLI through npx, with the exact version: `npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.2 share <file>` (or pipe Markdown into stdin). It encrypts locally and prints the full link, including the #k= key fragment. `npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.2 update <link|id> <file>` and `delete <link|id>` manage links created on the same machine; `npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.2 mcp` runs an MCP server; `npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.2 -h` lists every command and says if a newer version exists. Options: --expires 7d (shorter life) and --burn (one-time link). Before sharing, remove secrets or ask the user, and give them the whole link. Max 500 KB of Markdown, 10 writes per minute and 100 per day per address, links expire 30 days after creation, no account needed. Skill: https://md2pdf.studio/skill.md
